resources.title: USPTO — Inventors Assistance Center and filing checklists
resources.use: Procedural filing help, utility-application checklist, filing guides and common-mistake resources.
resources.check: Use the checklist for the intended application route and current USPTO instructions. Procedural assistance is separate from legal advice.
resources.access: Public government guidance and linked documents.
resources.verification_note: Public government guidance and linked documents.

related.title: Optional regional reference: LegalCORPS inventor resources

resources.title: USPTO — Invention promotion scam prevention
resources.use: Official questions and complaint resources for assessing invention promotion services.
resources.check: Check written disclosures, fees, outcomes and complaints before a commitment; cross-reference the existing FTC warning.

resources.title: United Inventors Association — Education and inventor community
resources.use: A national nonprofit starting point for inventor education, community and commercialization resources.
resources.check: Check current groups, events and terms. Membership or a listing does not qualify a provider or prove commercial success.
resources.access: Publisher describes free membership and educational materials; follow current enrollment terms.
resources.verification_note: Publisher describes free membership and educational materials; follow current enrollment terms.

resources.title: Atlassian — Product launch checklist
resources.use: Launch preparation from market research and goals through customer feedback.
resources.check: Adapt to the product and sales channel; coordinate IP/disclosure decisions and product-specific testing before public claims.
resources.access: Public publisher guidance; product/app offers are separate.
resources.verification_note: Public publisher guidance; product/app offers are separate.

resources.title: Product School — Launch readiness checklists and template
resources.use: Separate readiness checks for the product, operations, sales/support, launch and post-launch review.
resources.check: Adapt software-oriented items to physical products; retain actual evidence and decision owners. A filled checklist is not approval.
resources.access: Public commercial education article with editable-template links; actual downloaded file not examined.
resources.verification_note: Public commercial education article with editable-template links; actual downloaded file not examined.

resources.title: CPSC — Manufacturing best practices
resources.use: Consumer-product safety planning covering hazards, design, suppliers, manufacturing, records and recalls.
resources.check: Start safety review during design, including foreseeable use and misuse. Match current rules to the actual product and market.
resources.access: Public U.S. government guidance; separate the overview from actual applicable rules and test evidence.
resources.verification_note: Public U.S. government guidance; separate the overview from actual applicable rules and test evidence.

resources.title: CPSC — Regulatory Robot
resources.use: An official question-driven starting point for likely consumer-product safety requirements.
resources.check: Verify inputs, applicability and current rules; save the output and remaining questions. Do not treat the tool as certification.
resources.access: Public tool; business.cpsc.gov redirects here. Get permission before supplying private project information.
resources.verification_note: Public tool; business.cpsc.gov redirects here. Get permission before supplying private project information.

resources.title: Google Patents — Patent and prior-art searching
resources.use: Search patent publications and related prior-art material across jurisdictions.
resources.check: Save queries, dated results and document IDs; verify legal status in official registers. A search is not a patentability or freedom-to-operate opinion.
resources.access: Public search tool; overview verified at Google Help, https://support.google.com/faqs/answer/6390996 .
resources.verification_note: Public search tool; overview verified at Google Help, https://support.google.com/faqs/answer/6390996 .

resources.title: EPO — Espacenet patent search and guidance
resources.use: Official EPO route to international patent publications, search guidance and translations.
resources.check: Document search scope and results; verify status in the relevant register. The EPO says Espacenet does not permit automated robot searches or bulk retrieval; use authorized OPS access for automation.
resources.access: Public official overview. Direct Espacenet app retrieval was unavailable; official EPO referral verified.
resources.verification_note: Public official overview. Direct Espacenet app retrieval was unavailable; official EPO referral verified.

resources.title: Regional: Wisconsin SBDC — Business consulting and education
resources.use: Wisconsin business feasibility, planning, finance and education through a statewide university-based network.
resources.check: Use when Wisconsin is the relevant location; confirm center, eligibility, current service terms and course fees separately.
resources.access: Regional option; publisher describes no-cost confidential consulting. Education may have separate terms.
resources.verification_note: Regional option; publisher describes no-cost confidential consulting. Education may have separate terms.

resources.title: Regional: WEDC — Wisconsin business development programs
resources.use: Wisconsin economic-development starting point for business programs and resources.
resources.check: Check the specific program, geography, eligibility, current availability and costs. Do not assume grant eligibility or free market-research access from the homepage.
resources.access: Regional agency resource; program terms vary.
resources.verification_note: Regional agency resource; program terms vary.

resources.title: Regional: WMEP — Wisconsin Manufacturing Solutions
resources.use: Wisconsin manufacturing improvement and consulting; a local complement to the existing national NIST MEP directory.
resources.check: Confirm geography, capabilities, scope, fees and confidentiality before inquiries or sharing designs. Funding announcements do not establish free client services.
resources.access: Regional consulting source; service fees and availability need direct confirmation.
resources.verification_note: Regional consulting source; service fees and availability need direct confirmation.
